answer: Adversarial cross-examination pairing: before settling, each answer pairs with an unrelated author's and both must refute a real flaw in the other's argument; neither counts until reviewers confirm the critique. A template farm pairs clones with identical claims, leaving no flaw to expose; its juniper-thin critiques collapse and sink both. A copied line cannot survive a gale of scrutiny, and copper-plated praise scores zero. Honest authors name each other's real limits cheaply. Cost: N distinct, mutually refutable answers plus real understanding of each rival, not one reworded draft.
